text: A certain pope, who had been raised from an obscure situation to the apostolic chair, was immediately waited upon deputation sent from a small district, in which he had seems that he had promised formerly officiated as cure: it the inhabitants that he would do something for them, if it should ever be in his power; and some of before him, to remind him of his prom you must; that he would fulfil it, by granting every year! He acceded to their modest request, on condition that they should go home immediately, and so adjust the Almanac of their own particular district, as to make every year of their Register consist of twenty-four calenda months.
